jobs.description:
For our client, an international organization in Heverlee , we are looking for an experienced Accounts Payable Manager to lead the AP team. In this key role, you will ensure the accurate and timely processing of invoices and payments, maintain compliance with accounting and tax regulations and drive continuous process improvements.

Key Responsibilities :

• Lead, coach, and develop the Accounts Payable team.

• Oversee the end-to-end Accounts Payable process, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and timely execution.

• Coordinate invoice processing, payment runs, and AP-related financial controls.

• Manage monthly closing activities, reconciliations, accruals, and follow-up of outstanding items.

• Ensure compliance with VAT, tax, and internal accounting policies.

• Act as the main point of contact for AP-related matters across multiple stakeholders.

• Identify and implement process improvements, standardization initiatives, and automation opportunities.

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or equivalent through experience.

• Several years of experience in Accounts Payable within a multinational or complex organization.

• Strong SAP knowledge; experience with SAP S/4HANA is a plus.

• Solid understanding of VAT and accounting regulations.

• Proven experience leading and developing teams.

• Analytical, structured, and detail-oriented.Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

• Fluent in English, both written and spoken.

• Interest in process optimization, automation, and digital finance solutions.

About Fluves
 

Fluves is a pioneer in fiber optic sensing and subsea cable monitoring services. Through its Marlinks product line, Fluves delivers world-leading subsea cable integrity monitoring solutions to offshore wind operators worldwide by combining real-time data, advanced DTS & DAS technology, and smart analytics. Currently, Marlinks monitors over 1800km of power cables across the globe.
 

Your role
 

As Sales Manager at Fluves, you will be the commercial driver for the continued international growth of our Marlinks cable monitoring solutions. Your mission is to convert technical excellence into long-term customer relationships and revenue. You will work closely with our delivery, portfolio and development teams to bring the Marlinks product suite to the world’s leading offshore wind operators, utilities, and developers.
 

 
 

What you will do
 
 

• Own and drive the full sales cycle: from lead qualification and proposal development to contract negotiation and closing (for new and existing accounts) in the offshore wind sector. 

• Build and maintain a strong pipeline of international prospects across Europe, Americas, and Asia-Pacific, with a focus on developers, cable owners, operators, and EPC contractors. 

• Represent Fluves and the Marlinks product line at industry conferences and events (e.g. WindEurope, Global Offshore Wind, offshore energy summits), strengthening our brand and expanding our network. 

• Collaborate on the development and execution of territory plans, set ambitious sales targets, and report pipeline progress and market intelligence to the Head of Marketing & Sales Team. 

• Act as the voice of the customer internally, translating market feedback into product and service improvements in close collaboration with engineering and product teams. 

Who you are
 

You bring a combination of commercial drive, technical curiosity, and strong interpersonal skills. You:
 
 

• Have 5–10 years of B2B sales experience, ideally in offshore energy, cleantech, industrial monitoring, or related deep-tech sectors. 

• Are comfortable selling complex, technical solutions and can translate fiber optic monitoring into tangible business value for engineers, asset managers, and executives. 

• Are proactive, self-driven, and energized by building new markets from the ground up — you are a hunter and a builder. 

• Have strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to represent Fluves and the Marlinks product line confidently at senior levels and major international events. 

• Are willing to travel internationally (10-15%), to key markets in Europe, Asia-Pacific, and the Americas. 

• Are fluent in English. Additional languages are a strong asset.

jobs.description:
For a growing technical organization in the logistics sector, we are looking for a motivated Maintenance Technician who wants to contribute to the reliability and efficiency of industrial installations. As a Maintenance Technician, under the supervision of a supervisor, you will be responsible for the proper functioning of automated sorting systems and conveyor lines. 

Your responsibilities include: 

 
• Carrying out preventive maintenance according to the CMMS plan (Computerized Maintenance Management System). 
 
•  
Quickly and efficiently detecting and resolving technical faults. 

 
•  
Making technical improvement proposals based on your experience with breakdowns. 

 
• Advising your supervisor on technical optimizations. 
 
•  
Preparing intervention reports and correctly registering activities in the CMMS system. 

 
•  
Managing stock and following up on spare parts. 

 
•  
Training and supporting users in carrying out first-line maintenance. 

 
• Providing technical support to the operational teams. 

In the long term, you will also work in the Vilvoorde region.

 
• You hold a technical secondary education (TSO) or Bachelor's degree in electromechanics, industrial electricity, or automation. 
 

 
• You have broad technical knowledge of mechanics, electricity, automation, and pneumatics. 
 

 
• You have experience with industrial IT and CMMS systems. 
 
•  
Knowledge of sorting systems or conveyor systems is a plus. 

 
• You are fluent in English and either French or Dutch.

jobs.description:
Product Manager & Technical Support Engineer Textile Division

We are looking for a Product Manager & Technical Support Engineer for our Textile Division (EMEA). In this hybrid role, you combine strategic product management with hands-on technical support. You act as a key link between customers, Sales, R&D, and Operations, ensuring our products meet market needs and perform optimally in real-life applications.
 

Your responsibilities

 

• Manage and develop the product portfolio throughout its full lifecycle (from concept to phase-out) in close collaboration with R&D
• Translate market needs and customer feedback into product requirements and development priorities
• Define product positioning, value propositions, and technical differentiators
• Coordinate product launches, updates, and discontinuations across departments
• Monitor product performance, competitiveness, and profitability
• Provide technical expertise and training to internal stakeholders
 

Technical & Application Support:

• Deliver on-site and remote technical support (machine trials, testing, troubleshooting)
• Support customers during industrial trials and start-ups
• Analyze technical issues, identify root causes, and implement sustainable solutions
• Prepare and maintain technical documentation and reports
• Act as escalation point for complex technical issues
 

Collaboration:

• Act as technical interface between customers and internal teams
• Collect and structure customer feedback for continuous improvement
• Support Sales during customer meetings and project discussions
• Participate in customer visits, exhibitions, and industry events

Who are you?

 

• You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Materials Science, Chemistry, Textile Technology, or a related field
• You have experience in product management, technical support, or application engineering within an industrial environment
• You are analytical, hands-on, and solution-oriented
• You combine strategic thinking with a practical, customer-focused approach
• You communicate clearly with both technical and commercial stakeholders
• You enjoy working in an international environment and are willing to travel regularly within EMEA
• You are fluent in English (additional European languages are a plus)

Bedrijfsomschrijving 

This company repackages and stores frozen and chilled food products for numerous European businesses. These services are tailored to the specific needs of each customer. By 2025, the company aims to employ more than 300 people, who together handle 25,000 unique packaging orders. Working for this company means being part of a respectful environment where strong teamwork and dedication to the job go hand in hand.

Your responsibilities as a Reach Truck Operator include:

 
• 
Carrying out inspections and checks on incoming and outgoing goods.

 
• 
Placing incoming products in the correct locations within the warehouse and preparing outgoing goods for shipment.

 
• 
Scanning products into the system once they have been stored in the appropriate location.

 
• 
Primarily operating a reach truck, while also being comfortable using a forklift truck and pallet truck when required.

Interested? Read on to find out if you qualify!

 
• 
You hold a valid reach truck certificate.

 
• 
You already have some experience operating a reach truck. Stacking goods up to 10 meters high does not intimidate you.

 
• 
You are able to communicate in English with your colleagues.

 
• 
You will be working in a frozen warehouse at -18°C, operating an enclosed, heated reach truck. Appropriate protective clothing will also be provided by the company.

Welcome to Traxial: Where big ideas start small (but mighty)
 

Join Traxial as a 
Mechanical Design Engineer – Robotics and help shape compact, high-performance actuators for robotics. You’ll translate demanding motion requirements into practical, manufacturable mechanical designs. 
 

This is what you’ll do: 
 
 

•  

Design and develop mechanical solutions for robotic systems, from concept through prototype and production. 
   
 

•  

Create detailed 3D CAD models and 2D manufacturing drawings, applying relevant industry standards and GD&T. 
   
 

•  

Perform and support mechanical calculations and design verification to ensure performance, reliability, and durability. 
   
 

•  

Work closely with suppliers and subcontractors on components, manufacturing processes, tolerances, materials, and specifications. 
   
 

•  

Support prototype builds, testing, troubleshooting, and continuous design improvement. 
  

Who are we looking for? 
 
 

•  

Master’s degree in Mechanical or Electro-Mechanical Engineering, or equivalent experience. 
   
 

•  

At least 3 years of professional experience in the design and development of robotic systems, actuators, or precision motion systems. 
   
 

•  

Proficient in Siemens NX, Teamcenter PDM, or similar CAD/PDM tools. 
   
 

•  

Strong understanding of robotics system requirements and performance specifications, with the ability to translate payload, speed, torque, force, power, accuracy and duty cycle into mechanical design requirements. 
   
 

•  

Strong awareness of the latest trends and technologies in robotics, with a good understanding of emerging robotic architectures, actuation technologies, and motion solutions. 
   
 

•  

This position requires existing work authorization in Belgium. 
   
 

•  

A team player with a can-do mentality, creative mindset, and fluent English.

Welcome to Traxial: Where big ideas start small (but mighty)
 

Join Traxial as a Mechanical Design Engineer and take ownership for Precision Gearboxes . You'll work from concept to prototype and production, combining detailed mechanical design with hands-on validation.
 

This is what you'll do:
 
 

•  

Design and develop precision gearboxes for new product applications, from concept through prototype and production.
   
 

•  

Design mechanical components such as gears, shafts, bearings, housings, seals, and other transmission elements.
   
 

•  

Create detailed 3D CAD models and 2D manufacturing drawings, applying relevant industry standards and GD&T.
   
 

•  

Perform and support mechanical calculations and design verification.
   
 

•  

Work closely with suppliers and subcontractors on gearbox components, manufacturing processes, tolerances, materials, and specifications.
  

•  

Support prototype builds, testing, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of gearbox and actuator designs.
  

Who are we looking for?
 
 

•  

Master's degree in Mechanical or Electro-Mechanical Engineering, or equivalent experience.
   
 

•  

At least 3 years of professional experience in gearbox, drivetrain or precision mechanical component design.
   
 

•  

Proficient in Siemens NX, Teamcenter PDM, or similar CAD/PDM tools.
   
 

•  

Good knowledge of materials and manufacturing processes for gearbox components, including gear machining, heat treatment, tolerancing, and design-for-manufacturing principles.
   
 

•  

Strong analytical skills and experience performing mechanical calculations, such as gear sizing, shaft strength and bearing selection.
   
 

•  

Experience in Romax, KISSsoft or similar packages for gear calculation is a plus.
   
 

•  

This position requires existing work authorization in Belgium.
   
 

•  

A team player with a can-do mentality, creative mindset, and fluent English.

Your responsibilities include:

• Supporting different departments such as production, packaging, and dispatch.

The variety of tasks makes the role of production worker early shift both dynamic and rewarding.

Do you enjoy hands-on work and staying active throughout the day? Then you could be the production worker early shift we are looking for.

 
• Physically fit and comfortable with manual work.
 
• Willing to work with meat products.
 
• Comfortable working in a chilled environment.
 
• Able to work independently as well as part of a team.
 
• Flexible with early morning starts and shift schedules.
 
• As a production worker early shift, you can communicate in Dutch, English, French, and/or Romanian.
